items.text: Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on SS 112, OCS-00066, Well W-2.  The depleted "R-11" Sand was isolated by setting a plug @ 11150' MD and dumping ~60' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 11090'.  The "R-9" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 10906' - 10916' MD & 10856' - 10872' MD. Operations began on July 22, 2009, and ended on July 30, 2009.

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations to produce the "C-1" Sand in SS 98, Well #2BP1.  Operations began on August 16, 2009 and ended on August 29, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "D-2" Sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12350' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12300' MD.  The "C-1" Sand was then perforated from 9409' to 9413' MD.

ERT has successfully performed the initial completion operations of the EC 346 A12ST4 well.  Drilling operations began on 08-26-09, with the well TD'd at 9564' MD / 9439' TVD, w/a MW of 14.6 ppg SBM on 
09-12-09.  

The well was completed for production on 10-07-09.  The well was completed as a single, gravel packed, oil completion in the "Lentic 1-3" Sand with perforations of 9440' - 9494' MD.

Permanently isolated D-10 Sand, and added perfs to D-2 Sand.  The long string tubing was perforated at the same time the casing was perforated, and the D-2 sand is now flowing up the long string (short string tubing remains out of service due to mechanical problems).

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations on EI 243, OCS-G-02899, Well D-1ST to produce the "OW Upper" Sand.  Operations began on October 1, 2009 and were completed on October 6, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "OW Lower" Sand, perfs 12962' - 12982' MD, was isolated by setting a BP @ 12825' and dumping 18' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12807'.  The "OW Upper" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 12770' - 12800'.

Zone change operations on ST 34, OCS-G-04842, Well A-2ST1 have been suspended.  Operations began on February 11, 2010 and ended on February 26, 2010.  The previous completion interval, the "R-3" Sand was successfully isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12405' MD & dumping cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12356' MD.  It was then discovered that the production pkr @ 12207' MD is leaking and operations were suspended.  Note: There is no sustained csg pressure on the well.  An APM to address the leaking pkr @ 12207' MD and complete zone change operation to expose the "R-1" Sand to production, proposed perfs 12332' - 12350' MD, will be filed at a later date.  Per EOR database requirements, the well status has been noted as temporarily abandoned.

The MC 109 A15ST1 was spud on 04-18-10.  The well was drilled to a total depth of 9656' MD / 6063' TVD w/a MW of 12.4 ppg SBM.  Hole problems and lost circulation problems were encounted. The well was plugged back for by-pass operations.

The well was plugged back by setting an inflatable cmt retainer @ 5109' MD and setting 1524' balance cmt plug on top of the retainer, ETOC @ 3585'.  A 9 5/8" EZSV was then set at 3438' and 400 sxs of cmt were squeezed below to retainer to set a cmt plug from 3585' - 3438'MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 05-25-10.

The EI 302 w#04 well was spud on 04-23-10 and drilled to a total depth of 9950' MD / TVD on 04-24-10, w/a MW of 16.2 ppg.   7 5/8" prod. csg was set at TD and the well was then temporarily abandoned via a mud line suspension system.  TA operations were completed on 05-31-10 and the rig moved off location on 06-04-10.

Leed Petroleum LLC has successfully completed operations on the EI 183 A4 to add perforations to the existing "Tex X-2" Sand completion.
Perfs were added from 13654' - 13660' MD.

Operations began on 05-02-10 and were completed on 05-04-10.

Modify Perforations in the PL-9A by thru-tubing perforations from 11936'-11944'.  Set EZSV @ 11968'. Sqz perfs w/5 bbls cmt f/11974'-12018'. Test to 3000 psi. Set CIBP @ 11958'. Test to 2800 psi.  Pumped 19 bbls for cmt pkr from 10850'-11450'.  Perf tbg from 11936'-11944' in the PL-9A.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 93 #8ST1 well to produce the "M-11" Sd. The previous completion, the "M-12" sd, was abandoned by sqeezing cement into the existing perfs, leaving the ETOC at 14,700' MD. The "M-11" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 14,432'-14,457' & 14,470'-14,498' MD. Operations began on 08-25-10 and were completed on 09-05-10.

Due to the 9-5/8-inch and 13-3/8-inch casings being grouted together, McMoRan could not remove the casing strings.  McMoRan received approval from Cliff DeLouche on 08/24/2010 to set a 9-5/8-inch CIBP at 259-ft MD (85-ft BML) + 50-ft of cement leaving TOC at 209-ft (35-ft BML).

An attempt to zone change to produce the "T-10" sand was unsuccessful. The previous sand completion, the "U-1" sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12905' MD and dumped cmt to 12848' MD. Operations to complete the zone change to the "T-10" sand were suspended when it was determined that the production packer at 11860' may be leaking. Operations began 09/08/2010 and ended 09/16/2010.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 99 A1ST1 well to produce the "R-1" sd. The previous completion, the "S-1" sd, was isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12,700' MD  and dumping 54' of cmt on top of TTVBP, w/ ETOC @ 12,646' MD. The "R-1" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 12,342'-12,366' MD. Operations began on 09/18/2010 and were completed on 09/23/2010.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 46 A-10 well, but failed to produce the "Big A-3" sand. The previous completion, the "Big A-4" sand, was isolated by setting a cast iron bridge plug @ 7,465' MD and dumping 57' cmt on top of CIBP, ETOC @ 7,408' MD. Attempts to establish production from the "Big A-3" sand after punching holes in the concentric isolation assembly at 7,350'-7,354' MD & 7,341'-7346' MD  and exposing the perforations of the "Big A-3" Sand, failed.  The completion did not flow.   Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/06/2010.

Efforts to recomplete the subject well from the 7600' Sand to the Lower 7900' Sand have been suspended due to failure to fish lost wireline tools. Secured well by setting a DX Pump Through Plug at 2990'.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 112 V-4 well to produce the "R-14" sand. The previous completion, the "C-2" sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP @ 11,163' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the CIBP, w/ ETOC @ 11,113' MD. The "R-14" sand was exposed to production by perforating the intervals 10,870'-10,880' MD, 10,918'-10,930' MD, & 10,938'-10.950' MD. Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/18/2010.
triples: 50' of cmt on top of the CIBP, w/ ETOC @ 11,113' MD

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the EI 57 H-1ST1 well to produce the "BB-1" sand. The "BB-1" sand was perforated at intervals 11,471'-11,482', 11,487'-11,499', and 11,517'-11,527' MD. Operations began 05/29/11 and ended 06/02/11.

The L-22 Sand was then perforated from 8004'MD-8014'MD. Operations are stopped pending evaluation for future coil tubing operations. Well is shut in.

GA 272 A001: Current status: COM. TA was not complete due to problems with pulling the D plug stuck at 400'. A D Plug was set at 370' RKB and a BPV in tree on 4/24/15. Will require coil tubing to fish out the D plug at a later date.

Rigged up the Pride 1502 rig on slot 7 EB 161 A-13.  TIH w/ 13-1/2" directional BHA, washed out the drive pipe with 8.6 ppg seawater and surveyed.  Directionally drilled w/ 13-1/2" BHA to 2,890' MD.  Ran and cemented 11-3/4" casing.  Installed 11-3/4" wellhead.  NU and tested 13-5/8" 10M BOPE, and Weatherford?s RCH.  TIH w/ 9-7/8? directional BHA.  Displace seawater to 10.8 ppg SBM and drilled out shoe track and 10? of new formation and ran LOT to 11.9 ppg.  Slide drilled to 5,964' MD.  Ran 7-3/4" casing tagging up at 5,219? MD.  Unable to get deeper.  Cemented in place in 2 stages with the ICP/stage collar and set on back-ups slips in the wellhead at the surface.  P/U 6-1/2? x 7-1/2" BHA and drilled out cement and 10? new formation and ran LOT to 13.6 ppg which was not sufficient to get to TD.  Performed first EZ Squeeze at the 7-3/4? casing shoe.  Drilled to 6,162? MD and had losses that prevented further drilling.  Performed second EZ Squeeze across entire open hole section and again had losses that prevented drilling ahead.  Set two expandable liners, the second of which was successfully set at 6,162? MD.  Directionally drilled with 5-1/2? x 6-1/2? BHA to TD of 7,230' MD.  Ran and cemented 5" liner due to the smaller hole restriction.  Circulated 12.3 ppg SBM in the hole.  ND BOPE and installed dry hole tree and tested to 1,000 psi.  Skidded rig to slot 6 for A-1ST.
